name: BM25Plus
guidance: The BM25Plus algorithm adapts the standard BM25 scoring by incorporating a delta parameter to adjust document relevance scores. It utilizes a unified tokenization pipeline to convert query and corpus tokens into indices before applying the scoring formula. The implementation requires a custom backend selection mechanism to handle different numerical computation backends efficiently.
applicable_conditions: k must be less than or equal to the number of available scores in the corpus
delta parameter must be provided to adjust the final relevance score
limitations: The algorithm assumes a fixed vocabulary size and does not support dynamic vocabulary expansion
The delta parameter is not automatically calculated and must be explicitly set during initialization
